No locator error. Findings: all eleven confirmed, none downgraded. The two errors in stated results are the substantial ones and both counterexamples check out. E1's Lemma 2.2 uses the Cartier index of K_X where plt adjunction needs the index of K_X + S: on the A_1 cone with its ruling, K_X is Cartier so the printed m is 1, yet the ruling is not Cartier at the vertex, and with the log index m = 2 one gets the classical (K_X+S)|_S = K_S + ½ P, which the minimal resolution confirms. E6's Lemma 6.6 is false as stated: Spec Z_p[x,y,z,w]/(xy−zw) with the special vertex removed satisfies every hypothesis — normal, flat, excellent, smooth special fibre, the only singular point a closed point of X disjoint from X — and its ruling restricts to a Cartier divisor on the special fibre while failing to be Q-Cartier at the generic node. E2's Lemma 2.16 is false for the same A_1 surface with boundary bC, 0 < b < ½, where the single exceptional discrepancy −b/2 varies continuously while m = 1 and the pair stays ½-lc. E3 and E8 are two distinct sign slips in one proof, both against that proof's own convention C_i² = −r_i c_i. E4 and E5 are settled by the definitions printed two lines above them. E7 is a real gap: surjectivity of N¹ gives numerical representatives, not line bundles with prescribed restrictions. E9, E10 and E11 are confirmed verbatim, and E11's point is sharp — the degree-zero slope-zero term is exactly the contribution that produces the congruence being proved. No roadmap change beyond the two route-7 fields, no library claim and no Lean work is proposed by this review.
